EDI Analyst (EMEA) / Electronic Data Interchange Analyst / EDI Business Integration Analyst

Location: Bracknell
Hybrid (3 days in office)

Profectus Recruitment is working with an established international business to find an experienced EDI Analyst. You’ll take ownership of day-to-day EDI operations across EMEA and play a key role in moving trading-partner integrations from a legacy platform to Cleo Integration Cloud (CIC).

The role You’ll keep EDI transactions running smoothly, support and onboard trading partners, and investigate issues that could affect orders, deliveries or invoicing. You’ll also coordinate the migration of existing connections to CIC, including testing, go-live and early support.

You’ll work with internal teams, customers, suppliers and integration partners, while keeping processes and documentation clear and up to date.
What you’ll bring
  • Strong experience supporting EDI or B2B integrations in a live business environment.
  • Hands-on Cleo Integration Cloud experience — essential.
  • Experience onboarding trading partners, testing integrations and resolving transaction issues.
  • A practical understanding of common EDI standards and partner connections.
  • Experience with IBM Gentran or another legacy EDI platform, and platform migrations, would be an advantage.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to manage issues and priorities through to resolution.
Cleo CIC training or certification is highly desirable.

Please apply for an immediate response and the full spec.
